description: Brazilian NF-e/NFC-e XML-to-JSON compressor (~90% token savings), mathematical & CFOP tax auditor, 44-digit Access Key Mod-11 decoder, and LC 214/2025 CBS/IBS Tax Credit Auditor (single XML, batch xmls[], or direct items[]) with ready-to-send supplierAlert (0.01 USDC via x402 on Base).

accessKey.description: Optional 44-digit Brazilian NF-e access key (Chave de Acesso) to decompose UF, issue date, issuer CNPJ, model, number, and validate Mod-11 check digit. Alias: access_key.

aiSummary.description: Generate a concise accounting/tax audit summary via Cloudflare Workers AI (default: true).

auditRtcCredit.description: Enable LC 214/2025 CBS/IBS tax credit highlight audit & supplierAlert generation (default: true).

includeItems.description: Include line-item details (NCM, CFOP, ICMS/IPI/PIS/COFINS and CBS/IBS credit audit) in output (default: true).

items.description: Optional list of purchased items (NCM/cClassTrib/valor + highlighted CBS/IBS) for direct LC 214/2025 credit auditing without building XML.

referenceYear.description: Optional calendar year (2026..2033) for expected CBS/IBS rates (defaults to invoice issue year >= 2026, else 2026).

supplierEmail.description: Optional supplier email address to prefill supplierAlert.emailDraft for agent-email-x402 chaining.

xml.description: Raw Brazilian NF-e or NFC-e XML content (<nfeProc> or <NFe>, SEFAZ 4.00 / NT 2025.002 layout) to parse, compress (~90% token savings), mathematically audit, and audit CBS/IBS tax credits.

xmls.description: Optional batch array of up to 25 NF-e/NFC-e XML strings for fleet/procurement CBS/IBS credit auditing in a single call.

name: br_nfe_xml_auditor
